summary: Implemented the URL shortener service per the design: minimal-API endpoints for create/get/delete/redirect/health, ShortLink entity with EF Core SQLite persistence, cryptographically random Base62 codes with unique-index collision retry, URL/alias validation with private-host blocking, problem-details error responses.

files.reason: Web SDK project with EF Core SQLite and OpenAPI; warnings as errors.
FR6/NFR3 validation rules and ADR-4 private-host blocking.
EF model with unique Code index.

risks: EnsureCreated() will not evolve the schema when entities change; migrations must be introduced before any production deployment.
SQLite serialises writers; sustained high create throughput would need PostgreSQL.
assumptions: Unauthenticated delete is acceptable for v1 as stated in the requirement spec (A1).
Short URL host is taken from the incoming request; a configured public base URL can be added when deployed behind a proxy.
